name: @know-your-world/api
description: Cloudflare Worker API for Know Your World — score submission, leaderboards, health

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute know-your-world-db --remote --file=./schema.sql && npm run db:migrate:additive
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute know-your-world-db --local --file=./schema.sql && npm run db:migrate:additive:local
scripts.db:migrate:additive: for f in migrations/*.sql; do echo "Applying $f..."; wrangler d1 execute know-your-world-db --remote --file="$f" 2>&1 | grep -v 'duplicate column name' || true; done
scripts.db:migrate:additive:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do echo "Applying $f..."; wrangler d1 execute know-your-world-db --local --file="$f" 2>&1 | grep -v 'duplicate column name' || true; done
